source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Develop an emissions inventory that properly details the scope and frequency of the emissions.
3. Account for the types of pollutants being emitted and their emissions rate. Account for carbon dioxide and methane. 
4. Include the monitoring equipment and methods used.
5. Document instances of non-compliant emissions and actions taken to address them.
6. Compare the emissions data with applicable standards and regulations and provide an analysis of any variances. 
7. Describe mitigation measures implemented to minimize emissions and their effectiveness.
8. Include a summary of monitoring results over the reporting period.

Your job is first to properly interpret the emissions records from the company. Next, provide a detailed description of the process that was followed to create this report with a focus on accuracy rather than overly technical or advanced methods.
